title: Finite-sum assembly of single-degree homology isomorphisms
statement: Let C be any abelian category, choose its derived category D(C) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and let Q be the localization from cochain complexes. Let P be an integer-indexed cochain complex all of whose differentials vanish. Let s be a finite set of integers such that P.X n is a zero object for n outside s. Let K be an object of D(C), with H^n(K) a zero object for n outside s. Suppose for each n in s there exists a derived morphism f_n: Q(single_n(P.X n)) → K inducing an isomorphism on degree-n homology. Then Q(P) is isomorphic to K. The isomorphism is obtained by summing Q of the degree projections followed by the given f_n.

source.place: Tag 05RU (localization at quasi-isomorphisms); agent-written finite-sum assembly for original clopen rank-stratum reconstruction step 3.

proof.text: For each n, construct the cochain projection p_n from P to the single complex with P.X n in degree n by mkHomToSingle of the identity. This is a cochain map because P has zero differentials. On degree-n homology it is an isomorphism: ShortComplex.LeftHomologyMapData.ofZeros identifies its homology map with its identity degree-n component. Transfer this to D(C) using homologyFunctorFactors.

For each n in the finite set s choose the given derived map f_n. Construct g = sum over n in s of Q(p_n) followed by f_n. Additivity of the homology functor carries this finite sum to the sum of the homology maps. In degree n in s, all summands indexed by m different from n factor through the zero degree-n homology of a degree-m single complex. The remaining summand is the composite of two isomorphisms, H^n(Q(p_n)) and H^n(f_n).

For n outside s, the source homology vanishes because P.X n is zero and the target homology vanishes by hypothesis, so H^n(g) is an isomorphism between zero objects. Apply DerivedCategory.isIso_iff to all integer degrees and take asIso g. This includes an empty finite set: the empty sum is a morphism between two acyclic derived objects.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteZeroDifferentialAssembly
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C]
    (P : CochainComplex C ℤ) (hd : ∀ a b, P.d a b = 0)
    (s : Finset ℤ) (hP : ∀ n, n ∉ s → IsZero (P.X n))
    (K : DerivedCategory C)
    (hK : ∀ n, n ∉ s → IsZero ((homologyFunctor C n).obj K))
    (hlift : ∀ n, n ∈ s → ∃ f : Q.obj
      ((HomologicalComplex.single C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) n).obj (P.X n)) ⟶ K,
      IsIso ((homologyFunctor C n).map f)) :
    Nonempty (Q.obj P ≅ K)
